# The stone plinth under the pagoda: two square steps, 0.4 m in all (the first storey stands on it).
new
add mesh cube --name Low --size 1 --location 0 0 0.125
scale 3.0 3.0 0.25
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name High --size 1 --location 0 0 0.325
scale 2.5 2.5 0.15
apply --scale
material new Stone --base-color 0.549 0.561 0.682
select Low High
material assign Stone
select all
shade flat
export plinth.glb
